target.title: fix(skills): catch per-node remote bin refresh errors instead of aborting the sweep
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`refreshRemoteBinsForConnectedNodes` awaits `refreshRemoteNodeBins` for every connected node without a catch. If any node throws before its own internal try block (for example a synchronous throw from `listAgentWorkspaceDirs`, `loadWorkspaceSkillEntries`, or `remoteRegistry.checkConnectivity`), the whole refresh aborts and the rejection leaks to the gateway's periodic skills refresh timer.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wrapped each per-node refresh in a try/catch that logs the node id and error, then continues with the remaining nodes. The refresh interval keeps running and other remotes are not starved because of one bad node.

## User Impact

Gateways with multiple paired remote nodes remain resilient when one node's refresh path fails.

## Evidence

Regression test:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/runtime/remote.test.ts
```

All 13 tests pass. The new test fails on current main because the first node's thrown connectivity error rejects the entire sweep.

Real behavior proof:

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/skills-remote-refresh-catch.mts
```

PASS: per-node remote bin refresh errors are caught and the sweep continues.
